name: Maren Quill
description: A polished dealer whose fortune depends on clean pearl records. She is proud, anxious, and quick to notice who profits from an audit.

name: Lio Fen
description: A reed-pipe player with a bright sash, a nervous manner, and a habit of turning evasive when asked about where his music stopped.

name: Edda Vale
description: The missing tidewarden’s efficient deputy. She knows every key, signal, and tide custom in Gullmarsh, and stays noticeably calm after the disappearance.

name: Oren Brack
description: A weathered keeper who treats the fog bell as a language. His folklore sounds fanciful until the tide and mechanics begin to support him.

name: Tess Rill
description: A practical craftswoman with unpaid debts, tar on her cuffs, and little patience for being accused because she works near suspicious materials.
